name: user-vlm-gp-bench
description:
To ensure the model's robustness, generalization, and balance between avoiding excessive personalization and retaining user-specific comprehension, we employed four widely accepted benchmarks:

SEED (HuggingFace)
VQAv2 (HuggingFace)
LLaVA-COCO (HuggingFace)
In the Wild(HuggingFace)

These benchmarks are widely used in state-of-the-art evaluations of VLMs and provide diverse tasks and scenarios to rigorously assess performance. evaluation_method: task-dependent (accuracy for VQA; BLEU/CIDEr/SPICE for captioning; accuracy/IoU for grounding)
general_score_metric: task-dependent (e.g., accuracy for VQA, CIDEr/BLEU for captioning)
typical_sota_score: task-dependent; VQA accuracy ~70–90%, captioning CIDEr ~80–140 (varies by metric and setup)
reputation: A composite VLM evaluation suite aggregating established datasets (SEED, VQAv2, LLaVA-COCO, In the Wild); useful for broad VLM benchmarking though not a single standardized leaderboard.
